description: NaFeP₂(O₃F)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five PO₃F tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.53 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.29 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₃F tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to three O and one F atom to form PO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-47°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.54 Å. The P-F bond length is 1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to three O and one F atom to form PO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-49°. There is one shorter (1.52 Å) and two longer (1.53 Å) P-O bond lengths. The P-F bond length is 1.59 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Fe and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Fe and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Fe and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one P atom.
